body_lead: PARVATHIPURAM MANYAM; Gembali Gowtham, a 30-year-old Data Science and Artificial Intelligence graduate from Parvathipuram-Manyam district, is transforming agriculture through innovation. Despite hailing from a middle-class family in one of the State’s most underdeveloped regions, Gowtham has emerged as an inventor and entrepreneur, designed eco-friendly electric devices meant to ease the burden of small and marginal farmers and tribal communities. After completing his post-graduation from GITAM University and a master’s in AI in Mumbai, Gowtham initially pursued a career in software.
